highlights.title: Join codes that cannot be used say why
highlights.line: When a company join code is for another address, another email domain or a full company, Kosmos now says so instead of a retry.

highlights.title: A half-typed new agent says why it is back
highlights.line: Back from Settings within 30 minutes, New agent says it is where you left off, with Start over to clear the form.

highlights.title: Use short names keeps names you typed
highlights.line: When you make a team, Use short names now keeps any name you typed, and Another makes a row a suggestion again.

highlights.title: Settings says when crash recovery is not set up
highlights.line: On Windows, when you turn on start at sign-in and Kosmos has not set itself to reopen after a crash, Settings now says so.

highlights.title: The Kosmos app itself is read-only
highlights.line: The installed Kosmos app is read-only, so an agent's ordinary edit to the app your agents run on fails.
